::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 15 1872  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Katherine Wykes-Sneyd
:::

My dear [Pixie](people/person_539.qmd)
Your questions are all so good, I don't know which to choose, but I think we had better have the citizen of Athens, and the history of the Glorias[^1]

your faithful
Mother Goose

---

[^1]: The members of the [Gosling Society](organizations/other_104.qmd) took it in turns to pose questions for each other to write on, and the essays were read by CMY.
